title: Pocketwire Rewards Points Earning Standard for Card Purchases
content:
Pocketwire Rewards points are earned on settled Pocketwire debit card purchases at the tier's base rate plus the category bonus of the purchase's merchant category, within the caps below. The tier figures named here are the tier's base rate, category bonus rates, quarterly category bonus spend cap, direct-deposit rate lift and threshold, smallest purchase that earns, recurring charge setting, per-purchase and monthly caps, and maximum points balance.

## Earning rule

1. Points are earned only while the membership status is enrolled or active. The status is read from the membership record before the points are credited.
2. A settled card purchase of at least the tier's smallest purchase that earns earns the base rate plus the category bonus of its merchant category. Recurring purchases earn only on tiers whose recurring charge setting allows it.
3. The category bonus rate is the tier's grocery, dining, gas, travel, streaming or online retail bonus rate for a purchase in that merchant category; a purchase in any other merchant category has a category bonus rate of nothing.
4. The category bonus applies only to the part of the purchase that, added to the bonus-category spend already earned this quarter, stays within the quarterly category bonus spend cap; the rest earns the base rate only. The bonus-category spend already earned this quarter is the spend of earning entries of the membership in the grocery, dining, gas, travel, streaming and online retail categories dated in the calendar quarter containing the purchase date, up to and excluding the purchase being assessed.
5. When the linked personal account received direct deposits of at least the direct-deposit lift threshold in the calendar month before the purchase, the tier's direct-deposit rate lift is added to the base rate. This is how the personal account's deposit history lifts the rewards rate.
6. Points are rounded down to whole points per purchase, capped at the tier's most points on one purchase, and cut to what remains under the monthly cap and under the maximum points balance. The monthly figure is the points of the membership's earning entries dated in the calendar month containing the handling date.
7. The points are credited on the settlement date of the purchase.
8. A purchase earns points only once: points are credited only if no earlier earning entry points to the same card purchase, so a purchase the customer reports as missing is credited only when no earning entry exists for it.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Membership suspended or closed | status is not enrolled or active | no points |
| Purchase below the smallest purchase that earns | amount not at least the minimum | no points |
| Recurring charge on a tier whose setting does not allow it | recurring purchases do not earn there | no points |
| An earning entry already points to the purchase | purchase has earned once | nothing further credited |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Hypothetical tier figures: base rate 1.5 points per USD, dining bonus 2 points per USD, quarterly category bonus spend cap 5000.00 USD, most points on one purchase 10000. A settled dining purchase of 120.00 USD is assessed when the bonus-category spend already earned this quarter is 4950.00 USD.

- Room left under the cap: 5000.00 less 4950.00 is 50.00 USD, so 50.00 USD of the purchase earns the dining bonus.
- Base points: 120.00 USD multiplied by 1.5 is 180 points.
- Category bonus points: 50.00 USD multiplied by 2 is 100 points.
- Total: 280 points, under the per-purchase cap.

If, in the calendar month before the purchase, the linked personal account had received direct deposits reaching the threshold and the hypothetical tier's direct-deposit rate lift were 0.25, the base rate would become 1.75 points per USD: 120.00 USD multiplied by 1.75 is 210 points, and the total 310 points.

Rounding example (hypothetical): a grocery purchase of 33.33 USD at a base rate of 1.5 and a grocery bonus of 1, fully inside the cap, gives 49.995 plus 33.33, a total of 83.325, rounded down to 83 points.

Monthly cap example (hypothetical): with a monthly cap of 40000 points and 39950 points already earned this month, a purchase worth 280 points is cut to the 50 points that remain under the cap.
